core.why: +30% melee critical damage and +50% off-hand weapon damage: the reason to dual-wield; the biggest single multiplier of the build.
+20% on every attack with no pet; a melee hunter fights beside the mob anyway, so the pet's threat matters less than the damage.
Attacks against a marked target activate Mongoose Bite (10% chance at 2/2): Mongoose Bite every few seconds instead of only after a dodge, and Lacerating Strikes needs it.
-40% trap cooldown: Immolation Trap every 18 s instead of 30 s. The largest single move of the talent search (+4.3% on the dummy).
+30% Immolation and Explosive Trap damage (+3.1% on the dummy in the talent search).
+10% chance to hit with traps: a trap that misses a level-63 boss is 18 s of nothing (+1.1% on the dummy).
Every Mongoose Bite also bleeds for 40% of its damage over 21 s: the 31-point capstone of the melee tree.
+5% critical strike chance with all attacks, doubled in value by Predator's Edge's crit damage.
+4% crit on Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite, Counterattack and Strider Kick.
Under Aspect of the Beast every melee swing has a 10% chance of +30% attack speed for 12 s.
100% weapon damage every 8 s for a trivial mana cost, plus a sprint.
+5% damage against the tracked creature type: every raid boss is a beast, demon, dragon, elemental, giant, humanoid or undead.
+15% Agility: attack power and crit.
-60% mana on traps and melee abilities and regen on crits: the build never runs out of mana, which is why Efficiency measures zero.
Attack power from Intellect.

flex.why: Survival points on the way to the deeper talents: +6% health. Efficiency measures zero here (Resourcefulness already covers the mana), Deflection needs the boss to attack you.
+3% hit against a level-63 boss.

notes: Adopted 2026-09-29 (user request): the talentsforever.com #1 hunter build (5/11/35) beat the previous draft by +8.7% on the training dummy (380.1 vs 349.9) and +4.6% in the raid setting (791.7 vs 757.2) with the trap rotation, on two independent seeds (community simulator 40be98e). raidsim/talent_opt.py from both builds, dummy and raid: from the old draft it took exactly Survivalist's Discipline, Clever Traps and Survival Tactics (it paid with Deadly Aspects, which the simulator scores at zero because it lacks the melee haste proc); from this build no move wins. The old draft is kept as raidsim/candidates/cand-melee-dps-hand-2026-09-29.json.

Rotation: dual wield two fast one-handers; Aspect of the Beast on; Hunter's Mark and Serpent Sting from range on the pull, then Mongoose Bite when active, Strider Kick on cooldown, Raptor Strike on the next swing, and Immolation Trap under the boss whenever it is off cooldown (fire traps share a cooldown; Explosive Trap instead on packs).
No pet: Lone Wolf's +20% beats the pet's damage once the hunter melees (the model's raid pet share is 12%, the break-even 16.7%). Beast Mastery's pet talents are absent for that reason.

The community simulator plays this build on our own melee rotation (raidsim/specs.json melee-dps); it models only Aspect of the Hawk, so Aspect of the Beast's attack power and Deadly Aspects' haste are missing and the DPS is a lower bound. The fight lab's melee rotation has no traps yet, so the leveling numbers leave the trap talents at zero.

2026-09-29 filler audit, undone 2026-10-06: it had moved Improved Tracking 5 -> Deflection because the simulator measured Improved Tracking at 0, but that was the bench's blind spot: its target had no creature type, and Improved Tracking is +5% damage against every raid creature type but Mechanical (the bench's target is an Elemental since 2026-10-06; it reads +4.9% in a full raid now). The 5 points are back in Improved Tracking.

2026-10-15: the 70291 machine-learning search (ElliotWood/Forever 2ce8265 with this project's patches, ml_pipeline.py --fresh) confirms this build for Survival: its full-raid winner is +0.02% against it, under the 0.5% bar for a new build.

builds.name: Melee Survival leveling (dual wield, pet kept)
builds.summary: Leveling as a melee hunter with the pet as the tank: Survival's melee package first (Improved Tracking, Savage Strikes, Surefooted, Predator's Edge, Strider Kick at 30, Expose Prey, Resourcefulness), then Lethal Attacks, Lightning Reflexes, Careful Aim, Deadly Aspects and Focused Fire, and Lacerating Strikes at 58. No Lone Wolf, Improved Wing Clip or Improved Aspect of the Monkey: the pet holds the mob, so the hunter never needs to root, kite or dodge it. Adopted 2026-09-27 from opt-melee-dps-leveling-st, the fight lab's fastest melee build: 18.0/24.1/27.3/29.4/33.7 s per kill at 20/30/40/50/60 against 18.4/24.6/34.2/36.1/42.0 s for the previous Lone Wolf draft.

core.why: 100% weapon damage every 8 s: the biggest single talent at 60 (fight lab: +10.9% time per kill without it).
-60% mana on melee abilities and regen on crits: the melee loop runs out of mana without it (fight lab +11.5% at 60, almost all downtime).
+5% crit with all attacks, worth double with Predator's Edge (fight lab +6.1% at 60).
Mongoose Bite procs against the marked target: the second strike of the loop (fight lab +6.0% at 60).
+30% melee crit damage and +50% off-hand damage: the reason to dual-wield (fight lab +5.6% at 60).
Attack power from Intellect (fight lab +4.8% at 60).
+5% damage against the tracked creature type: every leveling mob has one (fight lab +3.6% at 60).
+15% Agility (fight lab +3.0% at 60).
Crit on Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite and Strider Kick (fight lab +2.9% at 60).
Pet damage: the pet tanks and still does a fifth of the damage (fight lab +2.2% at 60).

flex.why: Survival points on the way to Lacerating Strikes: with the pet tanking the hunter is rarely hit (fight lab +0.6% at 60).
Tier fillers for the capstone; the pet takes the hits, so parry procs are rare (fight lab 0.0% and -0.1% at 60).
+run speed between pulls; the fight lab uses a fixed 6 s travel, so only the scorer's travel value counts it.

notes: Pull with Hunter's Mark and Serpent Sting and send the pet; the pet holds the mob while you strike beside it: Mongoose Bite when active, Strider Kick on cooldown, Raptor Strike on the next swing.

Why no Improved Wing Clip, Improved Aspect of the Monkey or Lone Wolf (2026-09-27 scenario audit): a melee hunter stands next to the mob, so a root to open distance does nothing (fight lab 0.0% at 30 and 60); the pet keeps the mob off you, so dodge talents add nothing (0.0%); and dropping the pet at 51 made the hunter take every hit (downtime 3.4 s -> 10.3 s per kill at 60).
